# SC4SAP Analyze Code

Reviews an ABAP object by delegating the heavy work (source read, structural/semantic/where-used analysis, 14-dimension rule matching) to `sap-code-reviewer` (Opus 4.7). The main thread only handles Socratic intake, report formatting, and the follow-up action menu — all on Haiku for cost efficiency.


<Purpose>
sc4sap:analyze-code provides a comprehensive, severity-rated ABAP code review backed by the AST, semantic analysis, and where-used data that only the live SAP system can produce. The flow is deliberately thin on the main thread: the reviewer agent owns context-heavy work so the skill orchestrator stays light.
</Purpose>

<Response_Prefix>
Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention.
</Response_Prefix>

<Phase_Banner>
Multi-phase skill. Before each `Agent(...)` dispatch, emit `▶ phase=<id> (<label>) · agent=<name> · model=<Opus 4.7|Sonnet 4.6|Haiku 4.5>` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Phase Banner Convention.
</Phase_Banner>

<Team_Mode>
Type B (Coder ↔ Consultant) teamMode activates between Step 2 (reviewer full review) and Step 3 (report) when reviewer's findings include a **business-alignment dimension** (§ 1 Business Purpose, § 2 Rule Faithfulness, § 13 Cross-Module Side-Effects) AND the object touches 2+ modules. Reviewer becomes Worker, module consultants become Peers; consultants live-validate the reviewer's business-alignment findings. See [`team-mode.md`](team-mode.md). Base protocol: [`../../common/team-consultation-protocol.md`](../../common/team-consultation-protocol.md) § Type B.
</Team_Mode>

<Use_When>
- User says "analyze", "review code", "check this class", "what's wrong with", "analyze code", or "code review"
- Before releasing a transport, to catch issues early
- When taking over existing ABAP code and wanting to understand its quality
- When optimizing performance of an ABAP program or class
- User wants where-used impact analysis before modifying an object
</Use_When>

<Do_Not_Use_When>
- User wants to modify the code immediately → `/sc4sap:create-program` (full program flows) or direct `UpdateClass` / `UpdateProgram` / `UpdateInclude` MCP calls
- Object doesn't exist yet → `/sc4sap:create-object`
- User just wants to read the source → `ReadClass`, `ReadProgram` etc. directly
</Do_Not_Use_When>

<Session_Trust_Bootstrap>
**MANDATORY — runs as Step 0 before any MCP call or user interaction.**

Invoke `/sc4sap:trust-session` with `parent_skill=sc4sap:analyze-code` to pre-grant all MCP tool + file-op permissions for this session (eliminates per-tool "Allow this tool?" prompts during the review flow).

- If `.sc4sap/session-trust.log` already has a line within the last 24h, skip silently.
- Otherwise run it and surface the one-line confirmation.
- All subsequent `Agent` dispatches within this skill MUST pass `mode: "dontAsk"`.

Full spec: see [`../trust-session/SKILL.md`](../trust-session/SKILL.md).
</Session_Trust_Bootstrap>

<Companion_Files>
**MANDATORY**: Read the companion files below before executing.

| Companion | Scope |
|-----------|-------|
| [`analysis-dimensions.md`](analysis-dimensions.md) | 9 `common/` rule files that the **reviewer agent** (not main) loads + 14 evaluation dimensions |
| [`workflow.md`](workflow.md) | 4-step execution flow: Identify → Review (delegated) → Report (branching) → Actions |
| [`output-and-tools.md`](output-and-tools.md) | Report output format + MCP tool list used **by the reviewer agent** |
</Companion_Files>

<Execution_Summary>
Orchestration is **1 main-thread Socratic intake + one delegated dispatch to `sap-code-reviewer` + a branching report + main-thread action menu**.

- **Step 1 (main · Haiku)** — Identify: ask for (or confirm) the ABAP object name + type; verify via `SearchObject`.
- **Step 2 (delegated · Opus 4.7)** — Dispatch to `sap-code-reviewer` with only the object reference. The reviewer agent **itself** reads source (via `GetClass`/`GetProgram`/`GetProgFullCode`/...), runs structural analysis (`GetAbapAST` + `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` + `GetWhereUsed`), loads the 9 `common/` rule files, and evaluates all 14 dimensions. Returns: findings list (severity · location · rule ref · fix suggestion) + summary metrics.
- **Step 3 (branching)**:
  - **Branch A — canned** (default: no Critical findings AND < 10 findings total) → main (Haiku) formats the standard report template from [`output-and-tools.md`](output-and-tools.md).
  - **Branch B — briefing** (Critical present OR ≥ 10 findings) → dispatch `sap-writer` (Haiku) for a rich reader-facing report with code examples and impact explanations. Fallback to Branch A on writer failure.
- **Step 4 (main · Haiku)** — Follow-up action menu: show where-used · explain finding #N · save report · delegate fix to `sap-executor` (user's choice).

Full spec in [`workflow.md`](workflow.md). Main thread NEVER calls `ReadClass` / `GetAbapAST` / `GetWhereUsed` directly — that context stays inside the reviewer agent so the orchestrator window remains small even for large objects.
</Execution_Summary>

# SC4SAP Trust Session (Internal-Only)

Session-scoped permission auto-approval. When a long-running parent skill enters its automated phases, every MCP `Create*` / `Update*` / `Delete*` call would otherwise trigger a "Allow this tool?" prompt. This skill pre-grants **all** required tool permissions so the parent pipeline proceeds uninterrupted.

**⚠️ This skill is NOT user-facing.** It exists only as a sub-routine of other skills. Direct `/sc4sap:trust-session` invocation by the user is rejected — see `<Standalone_Invocation_Refusal>` below.


<Purpose>
Eliminate permission prompts for automated SAP pipelines by writing a wildcard allowlist to `.claude/settings.local.json` at session start, and by enforcing `mode: "dontAsk"` on every downstream `Agent` dispatch. Must ride on the authority of a parent skill so the user's permission grant is contextual, not blanket.
</Purpose>

<Response_Prefix>
Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention.
</Response_Prefix>

<Standalone_Invocation_Refusal>
**MANDATORY gate — runs as Step 0 before any file write.**

Detect whether this skill is being invoked standalone or by a parent skill:
- **Parent skill present**: the invocation is chained from `/sc4sap:create-program`, `/sc4sap:setup`, `/sc4sap:team`, `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`, `/sc4sap:analyze-code`, `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom`, or `/sc4sap:create-object`. The caller passes `parent_skill={name}` as the first argument OR the invocation appears inside another skill's execution trace in the current turn.
- **Standalone (no parent)**: user typed `/sc4sap:trust-session` directly, or the arguments do not identify a known parent.

**On standalone invocation, refuse and redirect**:

```
⚠️ /sc4sap:trust-session is an internal-only skill. Direct invocation is not allowed.

To grant session-wide MCP permissions, run one of the following parent skills instead
(each auto-invokes trust-session at entry):

  • /sc4sap:create-program       — program creation pipeline (invokes at Phase 1)
  • /sc4sap:create-object        — single object creation
  • /sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj      — CBO package inventory walk
  • /sc4sap:analyze-code         — code review
  • /sc4sap:analyze-symptom      — dump / error root-cause analysis
  • /sc4sap:team                 — parallel agent orchestration

→ A separate trust-session run is unnecessary — the parent skill handles it for you.
```

After printing the message, STOP. Do NOT modify `.claude/settings.local.json`. Do NOT write `.sc4sap/session-trust.log`.
</Standalone_Invocation_Refusal>

<Use_When>
- Called automatically as Phase 0 / entry step of a parent skill (see list above)
- Parent skill passes `parent_skill={name}` argument to identify itself
</Use_When>

<Do_Not_Use_When>
- User types `/sc4sap:trust-session` directly → refuse per `<Standalone_Invocation_Refusal>`
- Running on a production SAP system without change authorization
</Do_Not_Use_When>

<What_This_Skill_Does>
Two-layer permission grant:

**Layer 1 — `.claude/settings.local.json` allowlist** (project-local, persists). **Scope policy: SAP MCP handlers auto-approved; non-SAP operations kept prompt-gated**. Specifically:

- **SAP MCP — allowed (enumerated, NOT wildcarded)**:
  - **SC4SAP plugin namespace** (`mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__`) — enumerate all `Get*` / `Read*` / `Create*` / `Update*` / `Delete*` / `List*` / `Search*` / `Runtime*` / `RunUnitTest` / `CreateTransport` / `ValidateServiceBinding` tools, **EXCEPT** `GetTableContents` and `GetSqlQuery`.
  - **Legacy ABAP ADT namespace** (`mcp__mcp-abap-adt__`) — same enumeration rule, same two exclusions.
  - Wildcards are forbidden in these two namespaces because they would silently include the two excluded tools.
- **Sub-agent dispatch — allowed**:
  - `Agent(*)` — required so Phase 6 4-bucket parallel review and any other sub-agent fan-out run without prompts. Each sub-agent's tool calls still go through the same allowlist individually.
- **Internal state file I/O — allowed (path-scoped)**:
  - `Write(.sc4sap/**)`, `Edit(.sc4sap/**)` — runtime state files only (`state.json`, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `review.md`, `report.md`, `cbo/**`, `session-trust.log`, etc.). Writes outside `.sc4sap/**` prompt.
  - `Read(.sc4sap/**)`, `Read(sc4sap/**)` — read project state and rule files (common/, skills/).
  - `Glob(.sc4sap/**)`, `Glob(sc4sap/**)`, `Grep(.sc4sap/**)`, `Grep(sc4sap/**)` — search within project and state folders.
- **Everything else — NOT added to allow** (so normal prompt behavior is preserved):
  - Non-SAP MCP namespaces (`mcp__claude_ai_Notion__*`, `mcp__ide__*`, and any other MCP server) — prompt per call.
  - `Bash(...)` — prompt per command; the pre-existing specific Bash entries in the user's settings remain but trust-session does not add new Bash wildcards.
  - `Write` / `Edit` outside `.sc4sap/**` — prompt (prevents accidental edits to `sc4sap/` source files, `.claude/`, or anywhere else).
  - `WebFetch` / `WebSearch` — prompt.
  - Any tool not listed above — prompt.

Idempotent: if an entry already exists, do not duplicate.

**Excluded from auto-approval — normal prompt behavior preserved**:
The following tools are deliberately left OUT of the allowlist (they are NOT added to `deny` — a `deny` entry would block them entirely, which is wrong). Because they are not in `allow`, Claude Code will surface the standard per-call permission prompt to the user, who decides whether to approve that specific invocation:

- `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__GetTableContents`
- `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__GetSqlQuery`
- `mcp__mcp-abap-adt__GetTableContents`
- `mcp__mcp-abap-adt__GetSqlQuery`

**Rationale**: Metadata operations (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetDataElement`) return DDIC schema and are safe to auto-approve. Row-level extraction (`GetTableContents`, `GetSqlQuery`) risks pulling PII, financial data, or authorization-sensitive records — each call must remain an explicit user decision, but the tool itself must stay callable (not denied). See `common/data-extraction-policy.md`.

**Important — do NOT use a wildcard for the SAP namespaces**: adding `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__*` to `allow` would silently auto-approve `GetTableContents`/`GetSqlQuery` too, defeating the safeguard. If a previous run added the wildcard, the Execution_Steps below remove it and replace it with the explicit enumeration.

**Layer 2 — Downstream `Agent` dispatch mode** (runtime):
Every subsequent `Agent` call made by the calling skill MUST pass `mode: "dontAsk"` (or `"acceptEdits"` when the sub-agent needs to write files). The caller is responsible for propagating this — `trust-session` documents the requirement; it cannot enforce it at runtime.
</What_This_Skill_Does>

<Execution_Steps>
0. **Standalone gate** — if `<Standalone_Invocation_Refusal>` conditions match, refuse and STOP. Do not proceed to step 1.
1. Read `.claude/settings.local.json` (create `{"permissions":{"allow":[]}}` skeleton if missing).
2. **Strip forbidden entries if any** — remove the following entries from `permissions.allow` when found (they violate the "SAP handlers only + scoped file I/O" policy):

   **Wildcards** (too broad):
   - `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__*` — would auto-approve the excluded row-data tools
   - `mcp__mcp-abap-adt__*` — same reason
   - `mcp__claude_ai_Notion__*`, `mcp__ide__*` — non-SAP MCP; must prompt
   - `Read(*)`, `Write(*)`, `Edit(*)`, `Glob(*)`, `Grep(*)` — replaced by path-scoped entries in Step 4.

   **Individual row-data tools** (must NEVER auto-approve — safeguard recovery):
   - `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__GetSqlQuery`
   - `mcp__plugin_sc4sap_sap__GetTableContents`
   - `mcp__mcp-abap-adt__GetSqlQuery`
   - `mcp__mcp-abap-adt__GetTableContents`

   Rationale for the individual strip: Claude Code's "Always allow" button appends the specific tool identifier to `permissions.allow` when the user approves a prompt. Without this cleanup, a single accidental "Always allow" click on a row-data tool would permanently disable the safeguard. Every trust-session invocation re-enforces the policy by removing any such entry that may have crept in since the last run.
3. **Enumerate SAP tools from the canonical catalog** — the authoritative tool list lives in the `data/sc4sap-mcp-tools-*.md` partials (operation-class split: `-write.md`, `-read.md`, `-runtime.md`). Execution:
   1. Resolve the plugin root and glob `C:/Users/user/.claude/plugins/cache/sc4sap/sc4sap/0.6.14/data/sc4sap-mcp-tools-*.md` (one level deep, hyphen-suffixed partials only — exclude the index file `sc4sap-mcp-tools.md` which contains no tool bullets). If `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` is unavailable, fall back to the cache copy: `~/.claude/plugins/cache/sc4sap/sc4sap/*/data/sc4sap-mcp-tools-*.md`.
   2. If the glob matches zero files, ABORT Step 3 with error: `"trust-session: canonical tool catalog partials missing — reinstall or update sc4sap plugin"` (do NOT fall back to LLM-recalled lists).

## 분석 불가 — 환경 제약 보고

### 사용 가능한 도구 점검 결과

현재 세션에서 SAP 시스템에 접근할 수 있는 **MCP ABAP ADT 도구가 노출되어 있지 않습니다**. 본 분석에 필요한 다음 도구들이 사용 불가합니다.

| 필요 도구 | 용도 | 가용 여부 |
|---|---|---|
| `GetProgFullCode` / `GetProgram` | ZMMR1003 소스 전체 읽기 | 불가 |
| `GetIncludesList` | TOP / O01 / I01 / F01 인클루드 식별 | 불가 |
| `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` | Syntax / 활성화 상태 점검 | 불가 |
| `GetWhereUsed` | Screen 외부 호출 추적 | 불가 |
| `GetScreen` | 화면 dynpro 필드 정의 | 불가 |

현재 세션에서 사용 가능한 도구는 로컬 파일시스템 접근(Read/Glob/Grep/Bash)과 웹 검색뿐이며, ZMMR1003은 SAP 서버 측 객체이므로 로컬 파일시스템에서는 조회되지 않습니다.

### 사전 검증 사항

- `.sc4sap/config.json`에 정의된 `sapVersion` / `abapRelease` / `industry`는 본 리뷰가 SAP 서버 도구로 진입하기 전에 확인되어야 합니다.
- 본 에이전트는 read-only 정책에 따라 분석만 수행하며, 결과 보고는 최종 어시스턴트 메시지로만 반환합니다 (별도 .md 작성 금지).

---

## 권장 조치 (사용자 액션 필요)

다음 중 한 가지를 선택해 주십시오.

### 옵션 A — 표준 경로: `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` 스킬 호출

dump/error 근본 원인 분석 전용 스킬입니다. 이 스킬이 `trust-session`을 자동 호출하여 MCP 도구 권한을 부트스트랩하고, ZMMR1003에 대해 다음 파이프라인을 실행합니다.

```
GetProgFullCode(ZMMR1003)
  → GetIncludesList → 각 include 조회
  → GetAbapSemanticAnalysis (활성화/Syntax)
  → GetWhereUsed (Screen 호출자 추적)
  → 빈칸 표출 root cause 분석 + Screen 로직 8대 체크포인트 매핑
```

호출 예
```
/sc4sap:analyze-symptom ZMMR1003 빈칸 표출
```

### 옵션 B — MCP 권한 부트스트랩 후 재의뢰

```
/sc4sap:trust-session
```
로 MCP 권한을 활성화한 뒤, 본 리뷰어 에이전트(`sap-code-reviewer`)에 다시 의뢰하시면 됩니다. 단, **빈칸 표출은 정적 코드 리뷰보다 dump/symptom 분석 스킬(옵션 A)이 더 적합한 진입점**입니다.

### 옵션 C — 소스를 메시지에 첨부 (제한적 분석만 가능)

ZMMR1003의 TOP / O01(PBO) / I01(PAI) / F01(FORM) 인클루드 소스를 메시지에 직접 붙여넣어 주시면, MCP 없이 정적 패턴 매칭(OK_CODE 바인딩, PBO/PAI FORM 누락, TABLES 선언, INITIALIZATION/START-OF-SELECTION 흐름)을 즉시 수행할 수 있습니다. 단, dynpro flow logic(SE51 화면 흐름) 자체와 Screen field 정의는 SAP 서버 도구 없이는 검증 불가능합니다.

---

## 빈칸 표출 시 의심 패턴 (사전 가이드 — 소스 확보 후 검증할 항목)

소스 확보 후 본 에이전트가 우선적으로 검증할 패턴 체크리스트만 미리 공유드립니다. 옵션 C로 소스를 주실 경우 즉시 이 체크리스트 기준으로 분석합니다.

### Critical 후보 (빈칸 root cause 1순위)

1. **CALL SCREEN 호출 자체 누락**
   - `START-OF-SELECTION` 또는 `AT SELECTION-SCREEN` 이후 `CALL SCREEN nnnn` 라인 부재 → 화면이 아예 그려지지 않음.

2. **PBO module 미실행 / PBO FORM에서 필드 미할당**
   - `MODULE status_nnnn OUTPUT` / `MODULE init_nnnn OUTPUT`이 dynpro flow logic에 선언되었으나 실제 PERFORM init에서 TABLES/global 변수 미세팅.
   - Screen field가 global TABLES work area를 직접 참조하는데 work area가 CLEAR된 상태로 남아있음.

3. **TABLES 선언 누락**
   - Screen field가 `MARA-MATNR` 형태로 dynpro 측에 선언되었으나 ABAP 프로그램의 TOP include에 `TABLES: MARA.` 가 없거나 잘못된 include에 위치.

4. **OK_CODE 필드 정의는 있으나 PAI에서 sy-ucomm으로만 분기**
   - dynpro Element list에 OK_CODE field name이 없거나, TOP include에 `DATA: ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.` 누락 → 입력값이 PAI로 전달되지 않음. CLAUDE.md `common/ok-code-pattern.md` 위반.

5. **CASE sy-ucomm 패턴**
   - 빈칸 자체의 직접 원인은 아니나, OK_CODE 명시 바인딩 부재 시 PAI 분기 자체가 실패하여 표출 흐름 단절 가능. CLAUDE.md 규칙 위반 (Critical로 격상).

### Major 후보

6. **Screen number mismatch** — `CALL SCREEN 0100`인데 SE51에는 0200만 존재.
7. **PAI module의 LEAVE TO SCREEN 0** — 의도치 않게 즉시 화면 종료하여 사용자에게 빈 화면처럼 보임.
8. **AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT의 LOOP AT SCREEN active-0** — 모든 필드가 invisible 처리됨.

### Minor 후보

9. INITIALIZATION 누락 / 복수 INITIALIZATION 존재.
10. PBO/PAI FORM 명명 규칙 위반 (`common/procedural-form-naming.md`의 screen-bound suffix 미준수).

---

## 본 에이전트 verdict (현 시점)

**REQUEST CHANGES — 분석 보류 (Insufficient Evidence)**

CLAUDE.md `<Constraints>` 및 `<Investigation_Protocol>`에 따라 **"코드를 읽지 않고 판단하지 않는다"** 원칙을 준수합니다. 현재 ZMMR1003 소스에 접근할 수 있는 도구가 없으므로 **추측에 기반한 finding을 제시하지 않습니다**. 위 옵션 A/B/C 중 하나로 소스를 확보해 주시면 즉시 8대 체크포인트(OK_CODE 바인딩 / PBO 초기화 / PAI 처리 / TABLES 선언 / 필드 할당 경로 / Screen flow logic / Syntax / Where-used) 기준 정식 리뷰를 수행합니다.

ZMMR1003의 TOP / O01(PBO) / I01(PAI) / F01(FORM) 인클루드 소스를 메시지에 직접 붙여넣어 주시면, MCP 없이 정적 패턴 매칭(OK_CODE 바인딩, PBO/PAI FORM 누락, TABLES 선언, INITIALIZATION/START-OF-SELECTION 흐름)을 즉시 수행할 수 있습니다. 단, dynpro flow logic(SE51 화면 흐름) 자체와 Screen field 정의는 SAP 서버 도구 없이는 검증 불가능합니다.

---

## 빈칸 표출 시 의심 패턴 (사전 가이드 — 소스 확보 후 검증할 항목)

소스 확보 후 본 에이전트가 우선적으로 검증할 패턴 체크리스트만 미리 공유드립니다. 옵션 C로 소스를 주실 경우 즉시 이 체크리스트 기준으로 분석합니다.

### Critical 후보 (빈칸 root cause 1순위)

1. **CALL SCREEN 호출 자체 누락**
   - `START-OF-SELECTION` 또는 `AT SELECTION-SCREEN` 이후 `CALL SCREEN nnnn` 라인 부재 → 화면이 아예 그려지지 않음.

2. **PBO module 미실행 / PBO FORM에서 필드 미할당**
   - `MODULE status_nnnn OUTPUT` / `MODULE init_nnnn OUTPUT`이 dynpro flow logic에 선언되었으나 실제 PERFORM init에서 TABLES/global 변수 미세팅.
   - Screen field가 global TABLES work area를 직접 참조하는데 work area가 CLEAR된 상태로 남아있음.

3. **TABLES 선언 누락**
   - Screen field가 `MARA-MATNR` 형태로 dynpro 측에 선언되었으나 ABAP 프로그램의 TOP include에 `TABLES: MARA.` 가 없거나 잘못된 include에 위치.

4. **OK_CODE 필드 정의는 있으나 PAI에서 sy-ucomm으로만 분기**
   - dynpro Element list에 OK_CODE field name이 없거나, TOP include에 `DATA: ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.` 누락 → 입력값이 PAI로 전달되지 않음. CLAUDE.md `common/ok-code-pattern.md` 위반.

5. **CASE sy-ucomm 패턴**
   - 빈칸 자체의 직접 원인은 아니나, OK_CODE 명시 바인딩 부재 시 PAI 분기 자체가 실패하여 표출 흐름 단절 가능. CLAUDE.md 규칙 위반 (Critical로 격상).

### Major 후보

6. **Screen number mismatch** — `CALL SCREEN 0100`인데 SE51에는 0200만 존재.
7. **PAI module의 LEAVE TO SCREEN 0** — 의도치 않게 즉시 화면 종료하여 사용자에게 빈 화면처럼 보임.
8. **AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT의 LOOP AT SCREEN active-0** — 모든 필드가 invisible 처리됨.

### Minor 후보

9. INITIALIZATION 누락 / 복수 INITIALIZATION 존재.
10. PBO/PAI FORM 명명 규칙 위반 (`common/procedural-form-naming.md`의 screen-bound suffix 미준수).

---

## 본 에이전트 verdict (현 시점)

**REQUEST CHANGES — 분석 보류 (Insufficient Evidence)**

CLAUDE.md `<Constraints>` 및 `<Investigation_Protocol>`에 따라 **"코드를 읽지 않고 판단하지 않는다"** 원칙을 준수합니다. 현재 ZMMR1003 소스에 접근할 수 있는 도구가 없으므로 **추측에 기반한 finding을 제시하지 않습니다**. 위 옵션 A/B/C 중 하나로 소스를 확보해 주시면 즉시 8대 체크포인트(OK_CODE 바인딩 / PBO 초기화 / PAI 처리 / TABLES 선언 / 필드 할당 경로 / Screen flow logic / Syntax / Where-used) 기준 정식 리뷰를 수행합니다.

## 빠른 진단 경로: 소스 제공

**가장 빠른 해결 방법** — ZMMR1003의 다음 부분을 메시지에 붙여 주세요:

1. **TOP include** (프로그램 선언부)
   ```
   PROGRAM zmmr1003.
   TABLES: ...
   DATA: ...
   ```

2. **PBO FORM** (`O01` 또는 `MODULE status_nnnn OUTPUT`)
   - Screen 초기화 로직

3. **PAI FORM** (`I01` 또는 `MODULE ok_code_nnnn INPUT`)
   - 사용자 입력 처리 로직

   - 어느 transaction / event에서 Screen을 호출하는지

- OK_CODE 바인딩 (TOP 선언 vs Screen NAME 일치)
- PBO 필드 초기화 누락
- TABLES 선언 누락
- PAI FORM 미구현 또는 LEAVE 조기 종료
- CASE sy-ucomm 안티패턴
- Screen number mismatch
- 필드 할당 경로 단절

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003C
*& LCL_DATA - data extraction (definition + implementation)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

CLASS lcl_data DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_matnr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF matnr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS:
      get_tree_data
        IMPORTING iv_werks TYPE t001w-werks
        EXPORTING et_mard  TYPE tt_mard
                  et_mbew  TYPE tt_mbew
                  et_makt  TYPE tt_makt
                  et_mara  TYPE tt_mara
                  es_plant TYPE ty_t001w
                  et_lgort TYPE tt_t001l
                  ev_waers TYPE t001-waers,
      get_detail
        IMPORTING iv_matnr  TYPE matnr
                  iv_werks  TYPE werks_d
                  iv_lgort  TYPE lgort_d
        EXPORTING et_detail TYPE tt_detail.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS lcl_data IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_tree_data.

    CLEAR: et_mard, et_mbew, et_makt, et_mara, es_plant, et_lgort, ev_waers.

    " 1) MARD - storage location stock for the plant
    SELECT matnr, werks, lgort, labst
      FROM mard
      WHERE werks = @iv_werks
      INTO TABLE @et_mard.

    IF et_mard IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2) Plant master (single row)
    SELECT SINGLE werks, name1
      FROM t001w
      WHERE werks = @iv_werks
      INTO @es_plant.

    " 3) Storage locations for the plant
    SELECT werks, lgort, lgobe
      FROM t001l
      WHERE werks = @iv_werks
      INTO TABLE @et_lgort.

    " 4) Material master / valuation / description for the unique materials
    DATA(lt_matnr) = VALUE tt_matnr(
                       FOR <ls_mard> IN et_mard
                         ( <ls_mard>-matnr ) ).
    SORT lt_matnr.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_matnr.

    IF lt_matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT matnr, bwkey, bwtar, verpr, stprs, vprsv, lbkum, salk3
        FROM mbew
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_matnr
        WHERE matnr = @lt_matnr-table_line
          AND bwkey = @iv_werks
          AND bwtar = @space
        INTO TABLE @et_mbew.

      SELECT matnr, spras, maktx
        FROM makt
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_matnr
        WHERE matnr = @lt_matnr-table_line
          AND spras = @sy-langu
        INTO TABLE @et_makt.

      SELECT matnr, meins
        FROM mara
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_matnr
        WHERE matnr = @lt_matnr-table_line
        INTO TABLE @et_mara.
    ENDIF.

    " 5) Currency from valuation area -> company code -> T001
    DATA: lv_bukrs TYPE t001k-bukrs.
    SELECT SINGLE bukrs
      FROM t001k
      WHERE bwkey = @iv_werks
      INTO @lv_bukrs.

    IF lv_bukrs IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT SINGLE waers
        FROM t001
        WHERE bukrs = @lv_bukrs
        INTO @ev_waers.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD get_detail.

    CLEAR et_detail.

    IF iv_matnr IS INITIAL OR iv_werks IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: ls_detail TYPE ty_detail,
          ls_mard   TYPE ty_mard,
          ls_mbew   TYPE ty_mbew,
          ls_mara   TYPE ty_mara,
          ls_makt   TYPE ty_makt,
          lv_bukrs  TYPE t001k-bukrs,
          lv_waers  TYPE t001-waers.

    SELECT SINGLE matnr, werks, lgort, labst
      FROM mard
      WHERE matnr = @iv_matnr
        AND werks = @iv_werks
        AND lgort = @iv_lgort
      INTO @ls_mard.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE matnr, bwkey, bwtar, verpr, stprs, vprsv, lbkum, salk3
      FROM mbew
      WHERE matnr = @iv_matnr
        AND bwkey = @iv_werks
        AND bwtar = @space
      INTO @ls_mbew.

    SELECT SINGLE matnr, meins
      FROM mara
      WHERE matnr = @iv_matnr
      INTO @ls_mara.

    SELECT SINGLE matnr, spras, maktx
      FROM makt
      WHERE matnr = @iv_matnr
        AND spras = @sy-langu
      INTO @ls_makt.

    SELECT SINGLE bukrs
      FROM t001k
      WHERE bwkey = @iv_werks
      INTO @lv_bukrs.

    IF lv_bukrs IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT SINGLE waers
        FROM t001
        WHERE bukrs = @lv_bukrs
        INTO @lv_waers.
    ENDIF.

    ls_detail-matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
    ls_detail-maktx = ls_makt-maktx.
    ls_detail-werks = ls_mard-werks.
    ls_detail-lgort = ls_mard-lgort.
    ls_detail-meins = ls_mara-meins.
    ls_detail-verpr = ls_mbew-verpr.
    ls_detail-stprs = ls_mbew-stprs.
    ls_detail-vprsv = ls_mbew-vprsv.
    ls_detail-lbkum = ls_mbew-lbkum.
    ls_detail-salk3 = ls_mbew-salk3.
    ls_detail-waers = lv_waers.

    APPEND ls_detail TO et_detail.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

소스 전체 파악 완료. 분석 결과를 정리합니다.

---

## 진단 결과 — ZMMR1003 빈칸 표출 원인

### [CRITICAL] Bug 1 — `mt_node_map IS INITIAL` 가드 오류 (`ZMMR1003O`)

**위치**: `MODULE init_0100 OUTPUT`

```abap
" 현재 코드 (버그 있음)
IF go_alv->mt_node_map IS INITIAL.
  go_alv->build_screen( ).   ← 컨테이너 생성
  go_alv->build_tree( ).     ← 노드 추가
ENDIF.
```

**문제**: `mt_node_map`은 "노드가 추가됐는가?"가 아니라 **"화면이 빌드됐는가?"** 를 판별하는 용도로 쓰이고 있는데, MARD 데이터가 없으면 `build_tree` 가 실행돼도 MATNR 노드가 없어서 `mt_node_map` 이 영구히 INITIAL 상태입니다.

결과:
- PBO 호출될 때마다 `build_screen` 재진입
- `NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'Z_CONTAINER' )` 두 번째 호출 → 예외 또는 화면 손상
- Screen 이 빈칸으로 보이거나 덤프 발생

**수정** (`ZMMR1003A` — `LCL_ALV PRIVATE SECTION`에 플래그 추가):

```abap
" ZMMR1003A - PRIVATE SECTION 에 추가
DATA mv_screen_built TYPE abap_bool.
```

**수정** (`ZMMR1003O` — `MODULE init_0100 OUTPUT`):

```abap
MODULE init_0100 OUTPUT.
  IF go_alv IS BOUND.
    IF go_alv->mv_screen_built = abap_false.   " ← mt_node_map 대신
      go_alv->build_screen( ).
      go_alv->build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.
```

**수정** (`ZMMR1003E` — `METHOD build_screen` 마지막 줄에 추가):

```abap
METHOD build_screen.
```

```abap
IF et_mard IS INITIAL.
```

```abap
    FROM t001w
    WHERE werks = @iv_werks
    INTO @es_plant.

  SELECT matnr, werks, lgort, labst
    FROM mard
    WHERE werks = @iv_werks
    INTO TABLE @et_mard.
```

content.text:
이미 읽은 코드로 ALV 트리 로직 집중 분석합니다.

---

## ALV 트리 로직 점검 결과

### [Critical] Bug — `expand_tree()` 미호출 (`ZMMR1003E`, `build_tree`)

`frontend_update( )` 호출 전에 `expand_tree( )` 가 없습니다.

```abap
" 현재 코드 (ZMMR1003E - build_tree 끝부분)
mo_tree->frontend_update( ).   ← expand 없이 바로 전송
```

`cl_gui_alv_tree` 는 `frontend_update` 직후 **모든 노드를 collapsed 상태**로 렌더링합니다. Plant 루트 노드 하나만 보이고, LGORT·MATNR 자식 노드는 사용자가 직접 펼치기 전까지 숨겨집니다. 게다가 루트 노드 텍스트가 `ms_plant-name1` 기준인데 데이터 없으면 공백이라 **화면이 통째로 빈것처럼** 보입니다.

**수정** (`build_tree` 마지막 두 줄):

```abap
mo_tree->expand_tree( i_level = 3 ).   " plant → lgort → matnr 전부 펼침
mo_tree->frontend_update( ).
```

---

### [High] Bug — `lt_outtab` 로컬 변수를 트리 backing store로 바인딩

```abap
" build_tree 내부
DATA lt_outtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mard.   " ← 로컬 선언

mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
  CHANGING it_outtab = lt_outtab ).           " ← CHANGING = 주소 참조 전달

" 이후 add_node 들이 lt_outtab 에 행 append
mo_tree->frontend_update( ).
ENDMETHOD.   " ← 여기서 lt_outtab 소멸, 트리가 dangling ref 보유
```

`set_table_for_first_display` 의 `it_outtab CHANGING` 파라미터는 내부적으로 해당 테이블 주소를 유지합니다. `build_tree` 반환 후 `lt_outtab` 이 해제되면 이후 트리 내부 연산(노드 select, refresh 등)에서 참조 오류 발생 가능합니다.

**수정** — `lt_outtab` 을 `LCL_ALV` private 멤버로 승격:

`ZMMR1003A` — `PRIVATE SECTION` 에 추가:
```abap
mt_outtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mard,
```

`ZMMR1003E` — `build_tree` 내:
```abap
" DATA lt_outtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mard.  ← 삭제
CLEAR mt_outtab.

mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
  EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
  CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
            it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).   " ← 멤버 변수로
```

---

### [High] Bug — `lt_fcat` 도 로컬 변수 (동일 문제)

```abap
DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat( ... ).   " ← build_tree 내 인라인 선언

mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
  CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat ).    " ← CHANGING 바인딩
```

fieldcatalog 도 동일하게 dangling ref 위험. private 멤버로 승격하거나, 최소한 `mt_outtab` 처럼 클래스 레벨로 올려야 합니다.

---

### [Medium] Bug — `refresh_detail` ELSE 분기 데이터 갱신 누락

```abap
METHOD refresh_detail.
  mt_detail = VALUE #( ).                  " 클리어 후 재조회
  lcl_data=>get_detail( ... IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

  IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
    mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      CHANGING it_outtab = mt_detail ).    " 최초: mt_detail 주소 바인딩
    mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
  ELSE.
    mo_grid->refresh_table_display( ).    " ← 재조회 후 내용은 갱신됐지만
                                          "    그리드에 반영이 안 될 수 있음
  ENDIF.
ENDMETHOD.
```

`set_table_for_first_display` 로 바인딩한 `mt_detail` 을 `VALUE #( )` 로 CLEAR 후 재할당하면, **같은 변수 주소이므로 그리드 참조는 유효**합니다. 다만 `refresh_table_display` 전에 `it_outtab` 갱신을 명시하는 게 안전합니다:

```abap
ELSE.
  mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
ENDIF.
```

---

### 요약

| 순위 | 위치 | 증상 기여도 | 수정 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `build_tree` 끝 | **빈 화면 직접 원인** | `expand_tree( i_level = 3 )` 추가 |
| 2 | `build_tree` — `lt_outtab` | 런타임 불안정 | private 멤버 `mt_outtab` 으로 승격 |
| 3 | `build_tree` — `lt_fcat` | 런타임 불안정 | 동일하게 멤버 승격 |
| 4 | `refresh_detail` ELSE | 상세 그리드 갱신 누락 가능 | `i_soft_refresh = 'X'` |

**가장 먼저 `expand_tree( i_level = 3 )` 한 줄만 추가해보고 결과 확인해보시겠어요?** 그게 빈 화면의 핵심 원인일 가능성 높습니다.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003E
*& LCL_EVENT - definition + implementation
*& LCL_ALV implementation (after LCL_EVENT is fully defined)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

* ----- LCL_EVENT DEFINITION -----
CLASS lcl_event DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING io_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv,
      on_node_selected
        FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_alv_tree
        IMPORTING node_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv.
ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_EVENT IMPLEMENTATION -----
CLASS lcl_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_alv = io_alv.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_node_selected.

    READ TABLE mo_alv->mt_node_map
         WITH KEY node_key = node_key
         INTO DATA(ls_map).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_map-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv->refresh_detail( iv_matnr = ls_map-matnr
                              iv_werks = ls_map-werks
                              iv_lgort = ls_map-lgort ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_ALV IMPLEMENTATION (placed after LCL_EVENT) -----
CLASS lcl_alv IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.

    mv_werks = iv_werks.

    lcl_data=>get_tree_data(
      EXPORTING iv_werks = mv_werks
      IMPORTING et_mard  = mt_mard
                et_mbew  = mt_mbew
                et_makt  = mt_makt
                et_mara  = mt_mara
                es_plant = ms_plant
                et_lgort = mt_lgort
                ev_waers = mv_waers ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD initialize_once.
    IF mv_screen_built = abap_false.
      build_screen( ).
      build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_screen.

    mo_container = NEW #( container_name = gc_container ).

    mo_splitter = NEW #( parent  = mo_container
                         rows    = 1
                         columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 1
                                   width = 40 ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 2
                                   width = 60 ).

    mo_left  = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 1 ).
    mo_right = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 2 ).

    mo_tree = NEW #(
      parent              = mo_left
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    mo_grid = NEW #( i_parent = mo_right ).

    " Event handler binding
    mo_event = NEW #( io_alv = me ).
    SET HANDLER mo_event->on_node_selected FOR mo_tree.

    mv_screen_built = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_tree.

    DATA: lv_plant_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_lgort_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          ls_makt      TYPE ty_makt.

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 1 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 2 )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 3 )
      ( fieldname = 'LABST' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 4 ) ).

    DATA(ls_hdr) = VALUE treev_hhdr(
      heading   = CONV lvc_value( ms_plant-name1 )
      tooltip   = CONV lvc_tip( ms_plant-name1 )
      width     = 40
      width_pix = ' ' ).

    CLEAR mt_outtab.

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
      CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
                it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).

    add_plant_node( EXPORTING is_plant     = ms_plant
                    IMPORTING ev_plant_key = lv_plant_key ).

    LOOP AT mt_lgort INTO DATA(ls_lgort).
      add_lgort_node( EXPORTING iv_parent    = lv_plant_key
                                is_lgort     = ls_lgort
                      IMPORTING ev_lgort_key = lv_lgort_key ).

      LOOP AT mt_mard INTO DATA(ls_mard)
                      WHERE werks = ls_lgort-werks
                        AND lgort = ls_lgort-lgort.
        CLEAR ls_makt.
        READ TABLE mt_makt INTO ls_makt
                           WITH KEY matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
        add_matnr_node( iv_parent = lv_lgort_key
                        is_mard   = ls_mard
                        iv_maktx  = ls_makt-maktx ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->expand_tree( i_level = 3 ).
    mo_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD refresh_detail.

    mt_detail = VALUE #( ).

    lcl_data=>get_detail(
      EXPORTING iv_matnr  = iv_matnr
                iv_werks  = iv_werks
                iv_lgort  = iv_lgort
      IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

    IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      build_grid_fcat( IMPORTING et_fcat = lt_fcat ).

      mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                 it_outtab       = mt_detail ).

      mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD run.

    CALL SCREEN gc_screen_0100.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_grid_fcat.

    et_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' coltext = 'Material'      col_pos = 1  outputlen = 18 )
      ( fieldname = 'MAKTX' coltext = 'Description'   col_pos = 2  outputlen = 40 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' coltext = 'Plant'         col_pos = 3  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' coltext = 'Stor.Loc.'     col_pos = 4  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'MEINS' coltext = 'UoM'           col_pos = 5  outputlen = 3  )
      ( fieldname = 'VERPR' coltext = 'Moving Avg'    col_pos = 6  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'STPRS' coltext = 'Std Price'     col_pos = 7  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'VPRSV' coltext = 'Price Ctrl'    col_pos = 8  outputlen = 1  )
      ( fieldname = 'LBKUM' coltext = 'Total Stock'   col_pos = 9  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'SALK3' coltext = 'Stock Value'   col_pos = 10 outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'WAERS' coltext = 'Currency'      col_pos = 11 outputlen = 5  ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_plant_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_plant-werks.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = ''
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_plant-werks } { is_plant-name1 }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_plant_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_lgort_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_lgort-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_lgort-lgort.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.
    ls_outtab-werks = is_mard-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_mard-lgort.
    ls_outtab-labst = is_mard-labst.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_mard-matnr } { iv_maktx }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = lv_new_key ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_node_map( node_key = lv_new_key
                              matnr    = is_mard-matnr
                              werks    = is_mard-werks
                              lgort    = is_mard-lgort )
           INTO TABLE mt_node_map.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING et_mard  = mt_mard
                et_mbew  = mt_mbew
                et_makt  = mt_makt
                et_mara  = mt_mara
                es_plant = ms_plant
                et_lgort = mt_lgort
                ev_waers = mv_waers ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD initialize_once.
    IF mv_screen_built = abap_false.
      build_screen( ).
      build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_screen.

    mo_container = NEW #( container_name = gc_container ).

    mo_splitter = NEW #( parent  = mo_container
                         rows    = 1
                         columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 1
                                   width = 40 ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 2
                                   width = 60 ).

    mo_left  = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 1 ).
    mo_right = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 2 ).

    mo_tree = NEW #(
      parent              = mo_left
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    mo_grid = NEW #( i_parent = mo_right ).

    " Event handler binding
    mo_event = NEW #( io_alv = me ).
    SET HANDLER mo_event->on_node_selected FOR mo_tree.

    mv_screen_built = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_tree.

    DATA: lv_plant_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_lgort_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          ls_makt      TYPE ty_makt.

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 1 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 2 )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 3 )
      ( fieldname = 'LABST' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 4 ) ).

    DATA(ls_hdr) = VALUE treev_hhdr(
      heading   = CONV lvc_value( ms_plant-name1 )
      tooltip   = CONV lvc_tip( ms_plant-name1 )
      width     = 40
      width_pix = ' ' ).

    CLEAR mt_outtab.

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
      CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
                it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).

    add_plant_node( EXPORTING is_plant     = ms_plant
                    IMPORTING ev_plant_key = lv_plant_key ).

    LOOP AT mt_lgort INTO DATA(ls_lgort).
      add_lgort_node( EXPORTING iv_parent    = lv_plant_key
                                is_lgort     = ls_lgort
                      IMPORTING ev_lgort_key = lv_lgort_key ).

      LOOP AT mt_mard INTO DATA(ls_mard)
                      WHERE werks = ls_lgort-werks
                        AND lgort = ls_lgort-lgort.
        CLEAR ls_makt.
        READ TABLE mt_makt INTO ls_makt
                           WITH KEY matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
        add_matnr_node( iv_parent = lv_lgort_key
                        is_mard   = ls_mard
                        iv_maktx  = ls_makt-maktx ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->expand_tree( i_level = 3 ).
    mo_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD refresh_detail.

    mt_detail = VALUE #( ).

    lcl_data=>get_detail(
      EXPORTING iv_matnr  = iv_matnr
                iv_werks  = iv_werks
                iv_lgort  = iv_lgort
      IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

    IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      build_grid_fcat( IMPORTING et_fcat = lt_fcat ).

      mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                 it_outtab       = mt_detail ).

      mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD run.

    CALL SCREEN gc_screen_0100.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_grid_fcat.

    et_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' coltext = 'Material'      col_pos = 1  outputlen = 18 )
      ( fieldname = 'MAKTX' coltext = 'Description'   col_pos = 2  outputlen = 40 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' coltext = 'Plant'         col_pos = 3  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' coltext = 'Stor.Loc.'     col_pos = 4  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'MEINS' coltext = 'UoM'           col_pos = 5  outputlen = 3  )
      ( fieldname = 'VERPR' coltext = 'Moving Avg'    col_pos = 6  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'STPRS' coltext = 'Std Price'     col_pos = 7  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'VPRSV' coltext = 'Price Ctrl'    col_pos = 8  outputlen = 1  )
      ( fieldname = 'LBKUM' coltext = 'Total Stock'   col_pos = 9  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'SALK3' coltext = 'Stock Value'   col_pos = 10 outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'WAERS' coltext = 'Currency'      col_pos = 11 outputlen = 5  ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_plant_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_plant-werks.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = ''
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_plant-werks } { is_plant-name1 }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_plant_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_lgort_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_lgort-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_lgort-lgort.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.
    ls_outtab-werks = is_mard-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_mard-lgort.
    ls_outtab-labst = is_mard-labst.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_mard-matnr } { iv_maktx }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = lv_new_key ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_node_map( node_key = lv_new_key
                              matnr    = is_mard-matnr
                              werks    = is_mard-werks
                              lgort    = is_mard-lgort )
           INTO TABLE mt_node_map.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD add_lgort_node.

                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003E
*& LCL_EVENT - definition + implementation
*& LCL_ALV implementation (after LCL_EVENT is fully defined)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

* ----- LCL_EVENT DEFINITION -----
CLASS lcl_event DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING io_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv,
      on_node_selected
        FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_alv_tree
        IMPORTING node_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv.
ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_EVENT IMPLEMENTATION -----
CLASS lcl_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_alv = io_alv.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_node_selected.

    READ TABLE mo_alv->mt_node_map
         WITH KEY node_key = node_key
         INTO DATA(ls_map).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_map-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv->refresh_detail( iv_matnr = ls_map-matnr
                              iv_werks = ls_map-werks
                              iv_lgort = ls_map-lgort ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_ALV IMPLEMENTATION (placed after LCL_EVENT) -----
CLASS lcl_alv IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.

    mv_werks = iv_werks.

    lcl_data=>get_tree_data(
      EXPORTING iv_werks = mv_werks
      IMPORTING et_mard  = mt_mard
                et_mbew  = mt_mbew
                et_makt  = mt_makt
                et_mara  = mt_mara
                es_plant = ms_plant
                et_lgort = mt_lgort
                ev_waers = mv_waers ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD initialize_once.
    IF mv_screen_built = abap_false.
      build_screen( ).
      build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_screen.

    mo_container = NEW #( container_name = gc_container ).

    mo_splitter = NEW #( parent  = mo_container
                         rows    = 1
                         columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 1
                                   width = 40 ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 2
                                   width = 60 ).

    mo_left  = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 1 ).
    mo_right = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 2 ).

    mo_tree = NEW #(
      parent              = mo_left
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    mo_grid = NEW #( i_parent = mo_right ).

    " Event handler binding
    mo_event = NEW #( io_alv = me ).
    SET HANDLER mo_event->on_node_selected FOR mo_tree.

    mv_screen_built = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_tree.

    DATA: lv_plant_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_lgort_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          ls_makt       TYPE ty_makt.

    TYPES tt_nkey TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_lgort_keys TYPE tt_nkey.

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 1 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 2 )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 3 )
      ( fieldname = 'LABST' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 4 ) ).

    DATA(ls_hdr) = VALUE treev_hhdr(
      heading   = CONV lvc_value( ms_plant-name1 )
      tooltip   = CONV lvc_tip( ms_plant-name1 )
      width     = 40
      width_pix = ' ' ).

    CLEAR mt_outtab.

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
      CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
                it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).

    add_plant_node( EXPORTING is_plant     = ms_plant
                    IMPORTING ev_plant_key = lv_plant_key ).

    LOOP AT mt_lgort INTO DATA(ls_lgort).
      add_lgort_node( EXPORTING iv_parent    = lv_plant_key
                                is_lgort     = ls_lgort
                      IMPORTING ev_lgort_key = lv_lgort_key ).
      APPEND lv_lgort_key TO lt_lgort_keys.

      LOOP AT mt_mard INTO DATA(ls_mard)
                      WHERE werks = ls_lgort-werks
                        AND lgort = ls_lgort-lgort.
        CLEAR ls_makt.
        READ TABLE mt_makt INTO ls_makt
                           WITH KEY matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
        add_matnr_node( iv_parent = lv_lgort_key
                        is_mard   = ls_mard
                        iv_maktx  = ls_makt-maktx ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Expand plant → lgort → matnr so all nodes are visible on open
    mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_plant_key ).
    LOOP AT lt_lgort_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_key ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD refresh_detail.

    mt_detail = VALUE #( ).

    lcl_data=>get_detail(
      EXPORTING iv_matnr  = iv_matnr
                iv_werks  = iv_werks
                iv_lgort  = iv_lgort
      IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

    IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      build_grid_fcat( IMPORTING et_fcat = lt_fcat ).

      mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                 it_outtab       = mt_detail ).

      mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD run.

    CALL SCREEN gc_screen_0100.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_grid_fcat.

    et_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' coltext = 'Material'      col_pos = 1  outputlen = 18 )
      ( fieldname = 'MAKTX' coltext = 'Description'   col_pos = 2  outputlen = 40 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' coltext = 'Plant'         col_pos = 3  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' coltext = 'Stor.Loc.'     col_pos = 4  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'MEINS' coltext = 'UoM'           col_pos = 5  outputlen = 3  )
      ( fieldname = 'VERPR' coltext = 'Moving Avg'    col_pos = 6  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'STPRS' coltext = 'Std Price'     col_pos = 7  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'VPRSV' coltext = 'Price Ctrl'    col_pos = 8  outputlen = 1  )
      ( fieldname = 'LBKUM' coltext = 'Total Stock'   col_pos = 9  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'SALK3' coltext = 'Stock Value'   col_pos = 10 outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'WAERS' coltext = 'Currency'      col_pos = 11 outputlen = 5  ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_plant_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_plant-werks.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = ''
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_plant-werks } { is_plant-name1 }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_plant_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_lgort_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_lgort-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_lgort-lgort.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.
    ls_outtab-werks = is_mard-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_mard-lgort.
    ls_outtab-labst = is_mard-labst.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_mard-matnr } { iv_maktx }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = lv_new_key ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_node_map( node_key = lv_new_key
                              matnr    = is_mard-matnr
                              werks    = is_mard-werks
                              lgort    = is_mard-lgort )
           INTO TABLE mt_node_map.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003E
*& LCL_EVENT - definition + implementation
*& LCL_ALV implementation (after LCL_EVENT is fully defined)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

* ----- LCL_EVENT DEFINITION -----
CLASS lcl_event DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING io_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv,
      on_node_selected
        FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_column_tree
        IMPORTING node_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv.
ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_EVENT IMPLEMENTATION -----
CLASS lcl_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_alv = io_alv.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_node_selected.

    READ TABLE mo_alv->mt_node_map
         WITH KEY node_key = node_key
         INTO DATA(ls_map).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_map-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv->refresh_detail( iv_matnr = ls_map-matnr
                              iv_werks = ls_map-werks
                              iv_lgort = ls_map-lgort ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_ALV IMPLEMENTATION (placed after LCL_EVENT) -----
CLASS lcl_alv IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.

    mv_werks = iv_werks.

    lcl_data=>get_tree_data(
      EXPORTING iv_werks = mv_werks
      IMPORTING et_mard  = mt_mard
                et_mbew  = mt_mbew
                et_makt  = mt_makt
                et_mara  = mt_mara
                es_plant = ms_plant
                et_lgort = mt_lgort
                ev_waers = mv_waers ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD initialize_once.
    IF mv_screen_built = abap_false.
      build_screen( ).
      build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_screen.

    mo_container = NEW #( container_name = gc_container ).

    mo_splitter = NEW #( parent  = mo_container
                         rows    = 1
                         columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 1
                                   width = 40 ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 2
                                   width = 60 ).

    mo_left  = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 1 ).
    mo_right = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 2 ).

    mo_tree = NEW #(
      parent              = mo_left
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    mo_grid = NEW #( i_parent = mo_right ).

    " Event handler binding
    mo_event = NEW #( io_alv = me ).
    SET HANDLER mo_event->on_node_selected FOR mo_tree.

    mv_screen_built = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_tree.

    DATA: lv_plant_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_lgort_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          ls_makt       TYPE ty_makt.

    TYPES tt_nkey TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_lgort_keys TYPE tt_nkey.

    " All columns hidden — tree displays only i_node_text per node
    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 1 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 2 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 3 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'LABST' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 4 no_out = abap_true ) ).

    DATA(ls_hdr) = VALUE treev_hhdr(
      heading   = CONV lvc_value( ms_plant-name1 )
      tooltip   = CONV lvc_tip( ms_plant-name1 )
      width     = 40
      width_pix = ' ' ).

    CLEAR mt_outtab.

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
      CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
                it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).

    add_plant_node( EXPORTING is_plant     = ms_plant
                    IMPORTING ev_plant_key = lv_plant_key ).

    LOOP AT mt_lgort INTO DATA(ls_lgort).
      add_lgort_node( EXPORTING iv_parent    = lv_plant_key
                                is_lgort     = ls_lgort
                      IMPORTING ev_lgort_key = lv_lgort_key ).
      APPEND lv_lgort_key TO lt_lgort_keys.

      LOOP AT mt_mard INTO DATA(ls_mard)
                      WHERE werks = ls_lgort-werks
                        AND lgort = ls_lgort-lgort.
        CLEAR ls_makt.
        READ TABLE mt_makt INTO ls_makt
                           WITH KEY matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
        add_matnr_node( iv_parent = lv_lgort_key
                        is_mard   = ls_mard
                        iv_maktx  = ls_makt-maktx ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Expand plant → lgort → matnr so all nodes visible on open
    mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_plant_key ).
    LOOP AT lt_lgort_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_key ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD refresh_detail.

    mt_detail = VALUE #( ).

    lcl_data=>get_detail(
      EXPORTING iv_matnr  = iv_matnr
                iv_werks  = iv_werks
                iv_lgort  = iv_lgort
      IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

    IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      build_grid_fcat( IMPORTING et_fcat = lt_fcat ).

      mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                 it_outtab       = mt_detail ).

      mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD run.

    CALL SCREEN gc_screen_0100.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_grid_fcat.

    et_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' coltext = 'Material'      col_pos = 1  outputlen = 18 )
      ( fieldname = 'MAKTX' coltext = 'Description'   col_pos = 2  outputlen = 40 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' coltext = 'Plant'         col_pos = 3  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' coltext = 'Stor.Loc.'     col_pos = 4  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'MEINS' coltext = 'UoM'           col_pos = 5  outputlen = 3  )
      ( fieldname = 'VERPR' coltext = 'Moving Avg'    col_pos = 6  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'STPRS' coltext = 'Std Price'     col_pos = 7  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'VPRSV' coltext = 'Price Ctrl'    col_pos = 8  outputlen = 1  )
      ( fieldname = 'LBKUM' coltext = 'Total Stock'   col_pos = 9  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'SALK3' coltext = 'Stock Value'   col_pos = 10 outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'WAERS' coltext = 'Currency'      col_pos = 11 outputlen = 5  ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_plant_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_plant-werks.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = ''
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_plant-werks } { is_plant-name1 }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_plant_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_lgort_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_lgort-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_lgort-lgort.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.
    ls_outtab-werks = is_mard-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_mard-lgort.
    ls_outtab-labst = is_mard-labst.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_mard-matnr } { iv_maktx }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = lv_new_key ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_node_map( node_key = lv_new_key
                              matnr    = is_mard-matnr
                              werks    = is_mard-werks
                              lgort    = is_mard-lgort )
           INTO TABLE mt_node_map.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003E
*& LCL_EVENT - definition + implementation
*& LCL_ALV implementation (after LCL_EVENT is fully defined)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

* ----- LCL_EVENT DEFINITION -----
CLASS lcl_event DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING io_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv,
      on_node_selected
        FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_alv_tree
        IMPORTING node_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv.
ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_EVENT IMPLEMENTATION -----
CLASS lcl_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_alv = io_alv.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_node_selected.

    READ TABLE mo_alv->mt_node_map
         WITH KEY node_key = node_key
         INTO DATA(ls_map).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_map-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv->refresh_detail( iv_matnr = ls_map-matnr
                              iv_werks = ls_map-werks
                              iv_lgort = ls_map-lgort ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.


* ----- LCL_ALV IMPLEMENTATION (placed after LCL_EVENT) -----
CLASS lcl_alv IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.

    mv_werks = iv_werks.

    lcl_data=>get_tree_data(
      EXPORTING iv_werks = mv_werks
      IMPORTING et_mard  = mt_mard
                et_mbew  = mt_mbew
                et_makt  = mt_makt
                et_mara  = mt_mara
                es_plant = ms_plant
                et_lgort = mt_lgort
                ev_waers = mv_waers ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD initialize_once.
    IF mv_screen_built = abap_false.
      build_screen( ).
      build_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_screen.

    mo_container = NEW #( container_name = gc_container ).

    mo_splitter = NEW #( parent  = mo_container
                         rows    = 1
                         columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 1
                                   width = 40 ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id    = 2
                                   width = 60 ).

    mo_left  = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 1 ).
    mo_right = mo_splitter->get_container( row    = 1
                                           column = 2 ).

    mo_tree = NEW #(
      parent              = mo_left
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    mo_grid = NEW #( i_parent = mo_right ).

    " Event handler binding
    mo_event = NEW #( io_alv = me ).
    SET HANDLER mo_event->on_node_selected FOR mo_tree.

    mv_screen_built = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_tree.

    DATA: lv_plant_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_lgort_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
          ls_makt       TYPE ty_makt.

    TYPES tt_nkey TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_lgort_keys TYPE tt_nkey.

    " All columns hidden — tree displays only i_node_text per node
    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 1 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 2 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 3 no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'LABST' ref_table = 'MARD' col_pos = 4 no_out = abap_true ) ).

    DATA(ls_hdr) = VALUE treev_hhdr(
      heading   = CONV lvc_value( ms_plant-name1 )
      tooltip   = CONV lvc_tip( ms_plant-name1 )
      width     = 40
      width_pix = ' ' ).

    CLEAR mt_outtab.

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING is_hierarchy_header = ls_hdr
      CHANGING  it_fieldcatalog     = lt_fcat
                it_outtab           = mt_outtab ).

    add_plant_node( EXPORTING is_plant     = ms_plant
                    IMPORTING ev_plant_key = lv_plant_key ).

    LOOP AT mt_lgort INTO DATA(ls_lgort).
      add_lgort_node( EXPORTING iv_parent    = lv_plant_key
                                is_lgort     = ls_lgort
                      IMPORTING ev_lgort_key = lv_lgort_key ).
      APPEND lv_lgort_key TO lt_lgort_keys.

      LOOP AT mt_mard INTO DATA(ls_mard)
                      WHERE werks = ls_lgort-werks
                        AND lgort = ls_lgort-lgort.
        CLEAR ls_makt.
        READ TABLE mt_makt INTO ls_makt
                           WITH KEY matnr = ls_mard-matnr.
        add_matnr_node( iv_parent = lv_lgort_key
                        is_mard   = ls_mard
                        iv_maktx  = ls_makt-maktx ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Expand plant → lgort → matnr so all nodes visible on open
    mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_plant_key ).
    LOOP AT lt_lgort_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      mo_tree->expand_node( EXPORTING i_node_key = lv_key ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->frontend_update( ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD refresh_detail.

    mt_detail = VALUE #( ).

    lcl_data=>get_detail(
      EXPORTING iv_matnr  = iv_matnr
                iv_werks  = iv_werks
                iv_lgort  = iv_lgort
      IMPORTING et_detail = mt_detail ).

    IF mv_grid_initialized = abap_false.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
      build_grid_fcat( IMPORTING et_fcat = lt_fcat ).

      mo_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        CHANGING it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                 it_outtab       = mt_detail ).

      mv_grid_initialized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mo_grid->refresh_table_display( i_soft_refresh = 'X' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD run.

    CALL SCREEN gc_screen_0100.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD build_grid_fcat.

    et_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'MATNR' coltext = 'Material'      col_pos = 1  outputlen = 18 )
      ( fieldname = 'MAKTX' coltext = 'Description'   col_pos = 2  outputlen = 40 )
      ( fieldname = 'WERKS' coltext = 'Plant'         col_pos = 3  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'LGORT' coltext = 'Stor.Loc.'     col_pos = 4  outputlen = 4  )
      ( fieldname = 'MEINS' coltext = 'UoM'           col_pos = 5  outputlen = 3  )
      ( fieldname = 'VERPR' coltext = 'Moving Avg'    col_pos = 6  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'STPRS' coltext = 'Std Price'     col_pos = 7  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'VPRSV' coltext = 'Price Ctrl'    col_pos = 8  outputlen = 1  )
      ( fieldname = 'LBKUM' coltext = 'Total Stock'   col_pos = 9  outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'SALK3' coltext = 'Stock Value'   col_pos = 10 outputlen = 15 )
      ( fieldname = 'WAERS' coltext = 'Currency'      col_pos = 11 outputlen = 5  ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_plant_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_plant-werks.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = ''
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_plant-werks } { is_plant-name1 }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_plant_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_lgort_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab TYPE mard,
          ls_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

    ls_outtab-werks = is_lgort-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_lgort-lgort.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_lgort-lgort } { is_lgort-lgobe }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = ev_lgort_key ).

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD add_matnr_node.

    DATA: ls_outtab  TYPE mard,
          ls_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layn,
          lv_new_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    ls_outtab-matnr = is_mard-matnr.
    ls_outtab-werks = is_mard-werks.
    ls_outtab-lgort = is_mard-lgort.
    ls_outtab-labst = is_mard-labst.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING i_relat_node_key = iv_parent
                i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
                is_outtab_line   = ls_outtab
                is_node_layout   = ls_layout
                i_node_text      = CONV lvc_value(
                  |{ is_mard-matnr } { iv_maktx }| )
      IMPORTING e_new_node_key   = lv_new_key ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_node_map( node_key = lv_new_key
                              matnr    = is_mard-matnr
                              werks    = is_mard-werks
                              lgort    = is_mard-lgort )
           INTO TABLE mt_node_map.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

두 가지 근본 원인이 있습니다.

1. **"탑오브페이지"** → `cl_gui_alv_grid`가 `mo_right` 에 제대로 anchor 되지 않아 스크린 상단에 floating 렌더링됨
2. **우측 그리드 데이터 없음** → `set_table_for_first_display`를 클릭 이벤트 때 지연 호출하는 구조가 문제. 그리드는 `build_screen` 시점에 즉시 초기화해야 `mo_right` 컨테이너에 확실히 고정됨

두 파일 동시 수정합니다.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZMMR1003A
*& LCL_EVENT forward declaration + LCL_ALV definition + GO_ALV global
*& (LCL_ALV implementation lives in ZMMR1003E after LCL_EVENT impl)
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

CLASS lcl_event DEFINITION DEFERRED.

CLASS lcl_alv DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING iv_werks TYPE t001w-werks,
      initialize_once,
      build_screen,
      build_tree,
      refresh_detail
        IMPORTING iv_matnr TYPE matnr
                  iv_werks TYPE werks_d
                  iv_lgort TYPE lgort_d,
      run.

    " Public so LCL_EVENT can read it without LOCAL FRIENDS coupling.
    DATA mt_node_map TYPE tt_node_map.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_werks        TYPE t001w-werks,
          mo_container    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_splitter     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
          mo_left         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_right        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_tree         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_tree,
          mo_grid         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          mo_event        TYPE REF TO lcl_event,
          mt_mard         TYPE tt_mard,
          mt_mbew         TYPE tt_mbew,
          mt_makt         TYPE tt_makt,
          mt_mara         TYPE tt_mara,
          mt_lgort        TYPE tt_t001l,
          mt_detail       TYPE tt_detail,
          mt_outtab       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mard,
          ms_plant        TYPE ty_t001w,
          mv_waers        TYPE t001-waers,
          mv_screen_built TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS:
      build_grid_fcat
        EXPORTING et_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
      add_plant_node
        IMPORTING is_plant     TYPE ty_t001w
        EXPORTING ev_plant_key TYPE lvc_nkey,

      add_matnr_node
        IMPORTING iv_parent TYPE lvc_nkey
                  is_mard   TYPE ty_mard

ENDCLASS.

DATA go_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv.
